This file is for doing data import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(haven)
```

## Importing two datasets

Import out first dataset
```{r}
litters_df =
  read_csv(
    file = "data_file/FAS_litters.csv",
   na = c("", "NA",".")
  )
litters_df

# makes it into snake case 
litters_df =janitor:: clean_names(litters_df)
```
Import the pups dataset
using na formats all the missing values (.) and the NAs to read as missing 
```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv(
    file = "data_file/FAS_pups.csv", 
    skip = 3,
    na = c("","NA",".")
  )
  
pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df) 
  
```

## What's so bad about 'read.csv()'
Import pups with 'read.csv()
```{r}
pups_df_base =
  read.csv("data_file/FAS_pups.csv")

pups_df_base
```

Won't show: lazy about variable names; super slow for big datasets 

```{r}
select(litters_df, group, litter_number, gd0_weight, pups_born_alive)
select(litters_df, group:gd_of_birth)
select(litters_df, -pups_survive)
select(litters_df, GROUP = group, LiTtEr_NuMbEr = litter_number)

```


```{r}
relocate(litters_df, litter_number, pups_survive)

```


```{r}
# another way to rename variables 
rename(litters_df, GROUP = group)

# moves these variables to the front
relocate(litters_df, litter_number, gd0_weight)
```

In the pups data, select litter number, sex, and PD ears
```{r}
# shows only the variable you name 
select(pups_df, litter_number, sex, pd_ears)
```

## 'filter' some rows 
```{r}
filter(litters_df, gd_of_birth == 20) 

filter(litters_df, pups_born_alive <= 5)

filter(litters_df, pups_born_alive != 6)

filter(litters_df, group %in% c("Con7", "Con8"), pups_born_alive < 7) 

# removes the rows with the missing values for those variables 
drop_na(litters_df, gd0_weight) 
```

In the pups dataset, keep only rows where PD walk is less than 11 and sex is 2
```{r}
filter(pups_df, pd_walk < 11, sex == 2)
```

#mutate to change some columns

lets add and change some columns
```{r}
mutate(
  litters_df, 
  wt_gain = gd18_weight - gd0_weight,
  wt_gain_squared = wt_gain^2,
  group = str_to_lower(group))

```
In the pups dataset, create a variable that subtracts 7 from PD walk

```{r}
mutate(pups_df, pd_walk_minus_7 = pd_walk - 7)
```

```{r}
arrange(litters_df, pups_born_alive)
arrange(litters_df, desc(pups_born_alive))
```
